title: The Fox and the Goat
summary: A fox fell into a deep well and could not climb the sheer walls. A thirsty goat approached and asked if the water was good....
full_text:
A fox fell into a deep well and could not climb the sheer walls. A thirsty goat approached and asked if the water was good.

The fox praised the sweet taste of the water, urging the goat to jump down.

The foolish goat leaped in and drank her fill. The fox then placed his forepaws upon the goat's long horns, sprang nimbly out of the well, and looked down from the rim.

When the trapped goat cried for help, the fox called back: "Had you as much sense in your skull as you have hairs on your chin, you would have looked for a way out before leaping into the pit!"
moral: Look before you leap; consider the exit before you enter into an undertaking.
